● THE PIPELINE · IN MOTION
01 / 05
01IDEATE

Story becomes form.

Scripts, boards, animatics. The first physical shape of a film — pencil-tested, beat-mapped, and locked before a single frame goes into production.

02CAPTURE

Performance becomes data.

Full-body and facial mocap on one of India's most advanced optical stages. Every twitch, blink, and breath, captured at sub-millimeter precision.

03BUILD

Geometry becomes world.

Modelled, textured, rigged, lit. Cloth simulates, hair flows, FX ignites. The world is built one shader, one cache, one render pass at a time.

04COMPOSE

Frames become cinema.

VFX, DI, sound design, 5.1 and 7.1 mixing. The final assembly — where craft becomes feeling, and shots become a story.

05DELIVER

Cinema becomes screen.

Mastered, color-managed, version-locked, delivered. To theatres, to streamers, to broadcast — wherever your audience watches.
